##: Portable extraction from the official Inno Setup package. Scoop extracts the application payload; the vendor installer is not executed.
description: Windows SSD/HDD endurance monitor with ETW process attribution, SMART telemetry, write trends, and alerts.
notes: Scoop uses its native Inno Setup extraction. The vendor setup is not run, so no Windows service, Program Files installation, or startup entry is registered.

Start the collector with `dam-service`. It runs as a foreground console process; keep its terminal window open. Running elevated enables ETW process attribution and additional SMART/reliability data. Without elevation, some telemetry is reduced.
Start the tray dashboard with `dam-tray` or the Start Menu shortcut.

The application stores its database, machine configuration, and logs in `%ProgramData%\DiskActivityMonitor`; per-user settings are stored in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DiskActivityMonitor`. These locations are controlled by the upstream application and remain outside Scoop.
